user_query: I'm planning a family reunion in a coastal city and I need assistance finding hotels near the beach. Provide me with hotel details for the top-rated beachfront hotels in the city. Additionally, I would like to know if there is any live traffic on the way to the city.

TaskList.description: Search for top-rated beachfront hotels in the specified coastal city.
Retrieve details for the identified beachfront hotels, including name, price, and amenities.
